# Get all current Venmo friends using pagination.
venmo_token = venmo_login['access_token']
current_friends = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    friends = apis.venmo.search_friends(access_token=venmo_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)

    current_friends.extend(friends)
    if len(friends) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1
